audit.whatIsWrong: Yorick's W and E are swapped in nine strings. early, spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], whys[2], whys[4] and whys[6] all call the trapping wall his 'E mist-cage' or 'E cage', while wants.foe[1] separately and correctly calls Dark Procession his W. wants.you[1] and spikes[2] also have Rebuttal reflecting ghoul auto-attacks.
audit.why: Riot's text: W is Dark Procession, 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', 600 range on 20/18/16/14/12. E is Mourning Mist, 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets', 700 range on 12/11/10/9/8. The two do completely different jobs and the page merged them into one fictional ability, which loses the two facts that decide the matchup: the wall is destructible, so being boxed in is survivable if you attack it; and the mark, not the wall, is what makes Mist Walkers sprint at you. Mist Walker attacks are melee, so nothing supports reflecting them.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession is the destructible 600-range wall on 20s at rank 1; Mourning Mist is the 700-range armour-shredding mark on 12s that speeds his Walkers. The ghoul-auto reflect claim is removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Mel, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Mel, Yorick, Yorick — Mel loses levels 3 through 5, reclaims level 6 outright, then loses again. That bounce is a power shift that does not exist, and it contradicts whys[2] ('you control the wave'), whys[3] ('call it your edge') and whys[5] ('keeps it close').
audit.why: Mel is 550 range with a 950 Q against a melee whose gap-close is a thrown mark — the early and mid levels are hers and they run continuously, not in a Yorick-Yorick-Mel zigzag. At 40.98% over 1120 games the lane is decisively his, and that loss lives where the prose already puts it: Maiden plus items. Level 6 is genuinely even, Golden Eclipse against Eulogy of the Isles.
audit.corrected: Chart is now Skill, Mel, Mel, Mel, Skill, Yorick, Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side, with ratings 5, 7, 6, 6, 5, 4, 3 descending monotonically. whys[4] and whys[5] are rewritten to match. No mirror file exists (audits/top/yorick__mel.json), so this side sets the direction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was framed as purely Mel's, and Eulogy of the Isles is never named or timed anywhere in the content layer.
audit.why: Both ultimates land at 6. Golden Eclipse is 120/100/80; Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 and summons the Maiden, which 'will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies' — it converts every corpse in the lane into more bodies, which is why his side scaling starts at 6 rather than at two items.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now reads level 6 as even and names Eulogy of the Isles' Walker-raising.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds, though the full layer's itemization line already says to add anti-heal.
audit.why: Last Rites heals him on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 cooldown — that is a heal roughly every farm cycle, and it is the reason poke chip does not accumulate into an execute. The _missing file flags this matchup for anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: late names Morellonomicon against Last Rites and gives the 6s rank-1 cadence.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers, and tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d said Rebuttal is 'gone for twenty seconds'.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12 at 600 range and Mourning Mist 12/11/10/9/8 at 700 — the wall's 20-second rank-1 downtime is the actual window for stepping up, and it appeared nowhere.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and ranges written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid, tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: Yorick's E mist-orb is the only thing that turns this lane for him early — if it hits you it slows and cages you so his ghouls swarm, so sidestep it or pop Rebuttal to eat it. He's pure melee with ghouls until 6, so when he steps up to last-hit behind his ghoul line, throw Solar Snare to root him and dump Radiant Volley while he can't reach you. Your 550 range means his ghouls die or get out-spaced; just don't stand in the mist field stacking up free ghoul autos.
edits.after: Mourning Mist (E) is the only thing that turns this lane for him early — a 700-range globule on 12s at rank 1 that shreds your armour, slows you and marks you so his Mist Walkers sprint at the mark. Sidestep it or blank it with Rebuttal. He is pure melee with Walkers until 6, so when he steps up to last-hit behind his ghoul line, throw Solar Snare to root him and dump Radiant Volley while he cannot reach you. Dark Procession's wall is destructible — if he boxes you in, break it.

edits.before: This is your best stretch: your Q ranks up, Overwhelm stacks pile from repeated pokes, and at 6 Golden Eclipse detonates those stacks from any range — you can chunk him through his E cage without entering ghoul distance. Keep Rebuttal for his mist-orb engage and reflect the ghoul autos back as your own damage. Bait the cage, dodge it, then root-and-poke; never trade inside a full ghoul swarm with Maiden up because that's the only way he out-damages you here.
edits.after: This is your best stretch: your Q ranks up, Overwhelm piles from repeated pokes, and at 6 Golden Eclipse detonates those stacks from any range — you can chunk him over Dark Procession's wall without entering Walker distance. Keep Rebuttal for the Mourning Mist engage; blanking it denies the mark that makes his Walkers sprint. Bait the wall out (20s at rank 1), then root and poke; never trade inside a full Walker swarm with Maiden up, because that is the only way he out-damages you.

edits.before: Yorick is a hard scaler and this is where the EVEN lane tips to him. Once he has 2+ items and a permanent Maiden, his W wall plus E cage trap you in the side lane where your kiting room disappears and a full ghoul wave out-trades your poke. Don't try to 1v1 his split — your job is to shove and detonate from range, then group, and let your team answer the Maiden push. Without Flash up, a single landed cage is a death, so respect his all-in zones.

notes: Kit flag misfire: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) with 'dash'. Riot's text is 'throws a globule of Black Mist' with no movement on Yorick at all — the move speed goes to his summoned units toward the mark. I trusted the description and wrote no dash. The projectile flag on the same ability does match the description, so 'blank it with Rebuttal' is written as damage prevention, which Riot's Rebuttal text states outright; I made no claim about whether reflecting it returns the armour shred or the mark, since that is not in either file. Left alone as unverified: whether Rebuttal's damage prevention also stops Mourning Mist's mark from applying — this is the single most useful unknown in the matchup and worth a wiki check. Packet reports games:null for yorick while MC_REAL_GAMES.mel.yorick is 1120 — packet build defect. content.late begins 'this is where the EVEN lane tips to him'; the capitalised EVEN looks like a template token that leaked through, but it is inside a string I kept, so flagging rather than silently rewording.
